a70f272154c3675101197c4e8d26482c579927f3.sourceText: 本节点只写输出里程计的位姿，不转传输入速度和协方差，这些字段保持默认零值，不能据此判断车辆静止或估计没有不确定性。
a70f272154c3675101197c4e8d26482c579927f3.translatedText: This node only writes the pose of the output odometry and does not forward the input velocity and covariance\. These fields remain at their default zero values, and this cannot be used to determine that the vehicle is stationary or that there is no uncertainty in the estimate\.

a7564d127238b8986af1c4ae060585a1a6cdb6a2.sourceText: 文件加载失败只记录错误并返回，构造函数仍继续准备匹配目标，没有明确阻止空目标进入后续匹配；不能把“节点起来了”视为地图加载成功。源码不会在运行时重新读取PCD，也不会替你核对它与Nav2二维地图的位置、朝向、米制尺度或场地版本是否一致。
a7564d127238b8986af1c4ae060585a1a6cdb6a2.translatedText: If file loading fails, only the error is logged and the function returns; the constructor still continues to prepare the matching target, and there is no explicit prevention of an empty target from entering subsequent matching; the fact that "the node started up" cannot be regarded as successful map loading\. The source code will not re\-read the PCD at runtime, nor will it verify for you whether it is consistent with the Nav2 2D map in position, orientation, metric scale, or site version\.

a7744bfd8d1236fee1fdc9c4c7f580d0b2e2f82f.translatedText: only then is it worth considering\.

a7a4b8820690067de86611747c217c5bafa0a7c3.translatedText: When a class has pure virtual functions, this class is also called an ==abstract class==

a7b4fc76875088c1b475c36424a5d1f0a0199d3b.sourceText: `auto` 关键字告诉编译器："请帮我根据初始化的值，自动推导出这个变量的类型"。它并不是弱化类型安全——推导出来的类型在编译时就已经确定，所以仍然是强类型的。
a7b4fc76875088c1b475c36424a5d1f0a0199d3b.translatedText: `auto`The keyword tells the compiler: "Please infer the type of this variable automatically based on the initialized value\." It does not weaken type safety—the inferred type is already determined at compile time, so it remains strongly typed\.
